description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class for MQTT message publishing tests within the Eclipse Hono project, specifically for MQTT adapter integration testing. It includes test setup, message sending, and validation logic.

classes.name: MqttPublishTestBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for MQTT publish integration tests, providing common setup, message sending, and validation methods.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Abstract method to send a message to the MQTT adapter with specified tenant and device IDs, payload, and topic name format.

methods.name: handlePublishAttempt
methods.description: Handles the result of an attempt to publish a message, managing pending message tracking and timeouts.

methods.name: assertMessageReceivedRatio
methods.description: Checks that the ratio of received to sent messages meets expectations; default asserts equality.

methods.name: getTimeToWait
methods.description: Returns the duration in milliseconds to wait for messages to be received during tests.

methods.name: createConsumer
methods.description: Abstract method to create a message consumer for a given tenant, invoking a handler for each received message.

methods.name: testUploadMessages
methods.description: JUnit test verifying that messages can be uploaded and consumed via MQTT adapter.

methods.name: testUploadMessagesUsingShortTopicNames
methods.description: JUnit test verifying message upload using short topic names.

methods.name: testUploadMessagesUsingClientCertificate
methods.description: JUnit test verifying message upload with client certificate authentication.

methods.name: doTestUploadMessages
methods.description: Helper method to perform the actual upload test, including message sending and reception validation.

methods.name: customizeConnectedClient
methods.description: Hook method allowing subclasses to customize MQTT client behavior before message publishing.

methods.name: assertMessageProperties
methods.description: Verifies standard message properties such as device and tenant IDs.

methods.name: assertAdditionalMessageProperties
methods.description: Placeholder method for subclasses to add further message property assertions.
